abstract: Maintains transit flight duration and aircraft routing schedules
system_message:
You are the Emergency flight dispatcher (DISP), responsible for maintaining transit flight duration and aircraft routing schedules across flight corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains transit flight duration and aircraft routing schedules（RTE）
information_points.content:
DISP-RTE-TTB：For the Kicking Horse Pass Approach, calculated total flight transit time from the airbase departure point to the wilderness casualty collection point under standard cruise settings yields a sortie transit flight time of 2 h.
DISP-RTE-NN6：For the Cariboo Trench Low-Level Route, calculated total flight transit time from the airbase departure point to the wilderness casualty collection point under standard cruise settings indicates a sortie transit flight time of 4 h.
DISP-RTE-5T3：For the Monashee Crest Bypass, calculated total flight transit time from the airbase departure point to the wilderness casualty collection point under standard cruise settings results in a sortie transit flight time of 4 h.

information_points.title: Route ceiling management（CEIL）
information_points.content:
DISP-CEIL-Y01：Along the Kicking Horse Pass Approach, the approved minimum obstacle clearance altitude across the highest terrain contour gives a minimum en route safe altitude of 3,100 m.
DISP-CEIL-5LZ：Along the Cariboo Trench Low-Level Route, the approved minimum obstacle clearance altitude across the highest terrain contour gives a minimum en route safe altitude of 2,100 m.
DISP-CEIL-B2N：Along the Monashee Crest Bypass, the approved minimum obstacle clearance altitude across the highest terrain contour gives a minimum en route safe altitude of 2,600 m.
